title: sunset-pathfinder
description: Retire the cartographer-pathfinder writer subagent and replace the implementation loop with a single-writer context-engineering loop: strategic milestone compaction, minimal persisted state.json execution/resume state, and curated journal.jsonl lessons referencing existing .plan artifacts.

title: cartographer-pathfinder agent
description: Single-phase implementation writer subagent (read/bash/edit/write). The agent this proposal sunsets; its phase-writing duties move to the single parent writer.

title: implement skill
description: Phase-by-phase implementation workflow that delegates phase edits to cartographer-pathfinder by default. Primary rewrite target for the single-writer loop, minimal state.json orient/resume contract, and curated journal discipline.

title: proposal skill
description: Proposal workflow; references pathfinder only indirectly. Minor updates for the new state artifacts and read-only-only subagent posture.

title: plan skill
description: Planning workflow producing plan.md/plan.nodes/plan.edges. These remain authoritative per-topic planning artifacts that state.json references rather than duplicates.

title: README.md
description: Top-level docs: Cartographer subagents table, Clean Context Contract, receipts/context-packs, quick-start flow diagrams. Updated to reflect read-only-only subagents and new state artifacts.

title: ADR-0002 auditable subagent handoffs
description: Accepted decision assuming a delegated writer (pathfinder). Must be amended/superseded for the writer-subagent portion by a new ADR.

title: cartographer-tools extension
description: Extension exposing cartographer_index/jsonl/artifacts/validation/session/adr tools. Candidate home for minimal state validate/compact/current/journal helper commands over .cartographer artifacts.

title: validation_runner.py
description: Deterministic validation receipt writer (.plan/<topic>/receipts.jsonl). Existing basis for phase receipts that become the canonical compaction source of truth.

title: analyze_session.py
description: Session telemetry analyzer; produced the sanitized subagent-reliability evidence (calls/errors/durations/compactions). Useful for measuring context-engineering loop health.

title: manage_jsonl.ts
description: JSONL validate/upsert utility for map/fact/plan artifacts; reusable patterns for validating journal records and state refs against existing .plan JSONL artifacts.

title: cartographer-auditor agent
description: Read-only semantic gate after deterministic receipts. Retained; remains the post-loop semantic review authority.

title: cartographer-compass agent
description: Read-only scope/dependency/repeated-failure decision advisor. Retained for escalation decisions in the single-writer loop.

title: cartographer-archivist agent
description: Read-only research compressor. Retained as a read-only specialist (isolated exploration returning condensed summaries).

title: state.json (planned MVP, canonical)
description: Minimal execution/resume snapshot (JSON, schema-validated): topic, source_refs to .plan plan/receipt/context artifacts with hashes, current_phase_id, active_task_ids, active_validation_ids, singular next_action, working_set, known_failures, last_validation_receipt_ids, journal_refs, resume, updated_at. Does not duplicate the plan graph.

title: schemas/state.schema.json + journal.schema.json (planned MVP)
description: JSON Schemas for the MVP state snapshot and curated journal records, paired with cross-file invariant checks against existing .plan plan.nodes/edges and receipts.

title: cartographer state ACI (planned)
description: Minimal Agent-Computer Interface of semantic state commands (current set, state init/validate/set-next/set-working-set/record-validation-ref/mark-stale, journal append, compact.generate). Sole write path to state.json, journal.jsonl, and current.json; validates schema + cross-file invariants against existing .plan artifacts. Raw files remain the read path.

title: cartographer compact / compact.generate (planned)
description: Milestone compaction ACI command that rewrites the compact state.json execution/resume snapshot, may append only important journal lessons/summaries, and validates invariants against .plan artifacts (one next_action; IDs resolve; active files exist; forbidden/write scopes do not overlap; receipt IDs resolve; source hashes match or state is stale).

title: subagent-reliability proposal (evidence)
description: In-repo sanitized session evidence: 107 subagent calls, 17 errors, ~600s turns, 4 compactions, workers leaving the parent to finish. Empirical motivation.

title: git-worktrees proposal (single-writer safety)
description: Codifies one-topic/one-branch/one-worktree and one-writer-per-worktree safety; supports the single-writer end-state.

title: receipts.jsonl (existing)
description: Existing per-topic validation/fallback receipts. Extended as canonical phase-receipt source for compaction.

title: context-packs.jsonl (existing)
description: Existing compact handoff context records. Reused to seed orient/resumption reads.

title: plan.md (existing authoritative plan)
description: Existing per-topic human-readable implementation plan. Remains authoritative in the MVP; state.json references it by path/hash.

title: plan.nodes.jsonl (existing plan graph nodes)
description: Existing per-topic machine-readable phase/task/validation graph nodes. state.json validates current_phase_id, active_task_ids, and active_validation_ids against this file.

title: plan.edges.jsonl (existing plan graph edges)
description: Existing per-topic machine-readable dependency/contains/reference graph edges. Remains authoritative alongside plan.nodes.jsonl.

title: journal.jsonl (planned MVP, curated)
description: Per-topic append-only curated lessons journal. Stores only important lessons, gotchas, constraints, failed hypotheses worth not repeating, and milestone summaries that should survive compaction. Not a transcript, raw event stream, receipt log, or duplicate plan state.

title: current.json (planned MVP, ignored/local)
description: Git-ignored local active-topic pointer for the current worktree/session: active_topic, state_path, journal_path, worktree_id, git_branch, updated_at. Hint only; safe to delete or ignore when stale.
